faq.q: Do you supply lay flat hose for dewatering and frac water in Saudi Arabia?
faq.a: Yes. TPU lay flat hose from 1-1/2" to 16" goes to construction dewatering on Riyadh and Red Sea coast projects, to frac water transfer for Eastern Province gas work, and as flexible riser for farm and municipal boreholes, with grooved, flanged and high-pressure couplings and riser-winding equipment. Hose ships from Dubai as bulk coils up to 400 m or as made-up assemblies with couplings fitted, with the size table and pressure rating for each bore.

faq.a: Yes. TPU and NBR lay flat hose goes to Kuwait for oilfield water transfer, construction dewatering and fire water, sized for the flow and line length with couplings to match the pumps. NBR suits lines where oily water is expected; antistatic TPU hose is supplied for fuel transfer. Hose ships from Dubai as bulk coils up to 400 m or as made-up assemblies with couplings fitted, with the size table and pressure rating for each bore.
